flapjack: Enable backlight channel for Flapjack flapjack requires to enable LED Bias to control LCD backlight. For C18 boards, three channels are required, and each channel has a current of 24 mA. For C19 boards, four channels are required, each channel having a current of 23.5mA. BUG=b:124465980 BRANCH=none TEST=1:)When the system boots, the backlight will light up. 2:)Use the ectool commands to check the channel and current. channle: ectool i2cread 8 0 104 0xA0 current: ectool i2cread 8 0 104 0xA5 If it's C18 board, get 0xfa in channel command and 0xc8 in current command. If it's C19 board, get 0xfe in channel command and 0xc4 in current command. If the SKU value of the board is empty or incorrect, the default value is the data of the C18 board. CHROMIUM: Fix Bluetooth controller event mask config during system suspend As part of CL:1383763, a few Bluetooth controller events were disabled on suspension, to prevent the system from waking up spuriously. This change is applying the same event mask change as in CL:1383763, but instead of overriding the entire set of events mask it selectively masks out or restores the required events during suspend and resume. In addition, the new Set Event Mask operation introduced in this change is using the BlueZ/NewBlue new suspend and resume infrastucture. As part of suspend/resume operations, BlueZ sends a new MGMT command to the kernel to mask out/restore BT specified events. The kernel adds new functions to handle the Set Event Mask request. The request contains a value and mask parameters to enable overriding only selected events. For more details on the Bluetooth/NewBlue suspend infra refer to CL:1454328 BUG=chromium:930973 TEST=suspend and resume of system and verify event mask is set properly by the kernel. Verify event mask HCI and MGMT messages in BTMON. Signed-off-by: Yoni Shavit <yshavit@chromium.org> Change-Id: I8168f5451b61ae8d13cfd66d4924623990c506be Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1464385 Commit-Ready: Yoni Shavit <yshavit@chromium.org> Tested-by: Yoni Shavit <yshavit@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Shyh-In Hwang <josephsih@chromium.org> (cherry picked from commit 17346e853d5f9832d501edeb2c8a8c97d3b0b576) Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1483775

ish: fix LAPIC error by sending EOI to IOAPIC RTE ISH APIC has a bug when sending multiple IOAPIC interrupts to LAPIC at the same time, there's a small chance that the IRR (interrupt request register) states are not sync between LAPIC and IOAPIC REDTBL (redirection table). LAPIC raises internal error with error code 'receive illegal vector' in ESR. This CL handles above LAPIC local vector table error condition by comparing LAPIC IRR bits with IOAPIC REDTBL entries. And sends EOI (end of interrupt) to IOAPIC RTE if corresponding vector in LAPIC IRR was not set. BRANCH=none BUG=b:112750896,b:124128140 TEST=manual Cherry pick stress test program CL:1372875 and load on Atlas. Place a touch tester on TP and connect to ground. Chech console LAPIC error count and IOAPIC pending count. Change-Id: I1cddc91b2eca35719a83415f1548379574219a58 Signed-off-by: Rong Chang <rongchang@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1411953 Reviewed-by: Jett Rink <jettrink@chromium.org>

platform_EncryptedStateful: Disable reclamation check for kernels < 4.4 With b/80549098, PUNCH_HOLE was disabled for all kernel trees before 4.4. Disable the reclamation check for devices without the capability of PUNCH_HOLE. For such devices, the only difference is that if a file is deleted on the encrypted stateful partition, that space is not reclaimed into the stateful partition and encrypted stateful mount will monotonically grow upto the limit (30% of the stateful partition). cryptohome: create tracked subdirectories before mounting ecryptfs In b/115997660, files created behind ecryptfs' back are not initially visible: this is probably because a negative ecryptfs dentry doesn't effectively get revalidated. Instead, create pass-through directories before mounting. This should ensure that at the time of setting up the ecryptfs mount, all of the tracked directories are still present.
